title: Bugs Bunny Frenzy
description: A vibrant chaotic scene filled with multiple versions of Bugs Bunny in various costumes and poses, surrounded by colorful fruits, candies, and spheres. The central large Bugs Bunny gives a thumbs-up with one hand and points forward with the other, while smaller Bugs characters appear in the background including one as a wizard and others in dynamic stances.
prompt: Highly detailed vibrant illustration of multiple Bugs Bunny characters from Looney Tunes in a chaotic and playful scene, the large central Bugs Bunny with grey fur, white gloves, and orange shoes gives a thumbs up and points forward while smiling, surrounded by smaller versions including a wizard Bugs with purple hat, a blue suited Bugs, and others, all mixed with colorful oranges, candies, spheres and fruits floating throughout the composition, dynamic and fun arrangement with rich textures and bright lighting
